sources.entry: AI Router - Hosted OpenAI-compatible API relay with unified multi-model access, personal API keys, and per-key usage visibility. #freemium

summary.name: AI-ROUTER
summary.one_liner: A hosted, OpenAI-compatible API gateway that routes ChatGPT-style model traffic with subscription quotas, USD balance billing, and admin controls.
use_cases: Point OpenAI SDK clients at a relay via base_url
Use Codex or other coding agents through a hosted relay
Manage subscription quotas and USD balance for API access
Distribute AI API access and handle billing and payouts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform for routing model API traffic through one gateway, covering channel pricing, subscription quotas, USD balance billing, payments, proxies, policy controls, referrals, and affiliate attribution. Customers can choose subscription packages for managed quotas or "fuel" packages for USD balance billing, and packages are loaded from the live catalog. The console handles billing rules, account health, payment records, proxy allocation, audit trails, and growth payouts. The meta description additionally says it offers an OpenAI-compatible API relay with personal API keys, per-key usage queries, and base_url setup for Codex and coding agents. The page text itself is mostly marketing and gives no concrete pricing figures.
notable: OpenAI-compatible relay usable by changing the OpenAI base_url
Subscription packages for managed quotas or USD balance ('fuel') packages
Admin side includes audit trails, account health controls, and affiliate/referral payouts
Public site links to an authenticated console for configuration and payments
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; packages are only shown from the live catalog
Public page explains the platform; real configuration and payments require logging into the console
Aimed at enterprise and distribution operators; the page does not describe a free tier beyond the listing's 'freemium' tag
